common_preconditions: Source-qualified native simple reciprocal unweighted graph; loops excluded from removal and neighborhood groups, retained for exact native normalization.
Actual fit-role labels only. One predetermined class-count-preserving permutation of fit-label slots. Auxiliary permuted labels affect edge categories only; true target/group/CE labels do not change.
Original same/other mask unit counts are fixed by floor10percent sampling. Full graph/native degrees use all unlabeled public edges, not heldout labels.
Predetermined seeds and fixed hash-priority order. One instance per block, no permutation retries, no selective feasible-mask/outcome search, no tolerance/coarse-bin repair.
Record identity/noninformative permutations rather than retry silently; root must specify their admission disposition before any data/outcomes.
Any unsupported graph, infeasibility, missing exact solver qualification or timeout stops admission rather than substituting an unannounced control.

alternative_A.name: exact per-node removed-degree and per-view count null
alternative_A.variables: Binary x_e^same and x_e^other for canonical edges admitted by the once-permuted same/different relation
alternative_A.constraints: For each view, sum_e x equals original removed-unit count. For every node v, sum_{incident e}x equals its original per-view removed degree. Category sets are disjoint. Original exact graph/node IDs are retained.
alternative_A.solution_selection: Lexicographically preferred selected-bit vector under fixed hash-priority edge order, from one exact feasibility instance. Distribution is precisely algorithm-defined, not claimed uniform over feasible masks.
alternative_A.implementation: Instance, necessary capacity checks and independent feasibility-certificate checker prepared. A pinned exact undirected b-matching/MILP oracle with deterministic lex selection and infeasibility/timeout certificates remains required; no pretend heuristic solver supplied.
alternative_A.feasibility_risk: Permutation may leave a node too few eligible same/other incident edges or cause global exact-degree incompatibility. No actual graph feasibility was inspected.
alternative_A.failure_policy: Block/arm unavailable; required falsifier/control cannot be launched. Do not draw another permutation or weaken matching.
alternative_A.scientific_scope: Preserves which nodes lose how many edges in each view, while changing the label relation selecting removed evidence. Normalized neighbor identities and path effects can still differ. Not causal certification.

alternative_B.name: exact native-degree-pair distribution and per-view count null
alternative_B.strata: (view, min native degree including one gcn self-loop, max native degree including one gcn self-loop), exact integer degrees, no bins
alternative_B.constraints: Count of removed edge units in every exact native-degree-pair stratum equals original mask count. This also fixes total removed-unit count and endpoint native-degree distribution, but not each node's removed degree.
alternative_B.selection: One once-permuted category pool per stratum; fixed hash-priority subset of required size. An insufficient stratum is a complete immediate infeasibility certificate; no search or repair.
alternative_B.implementation: Complete stdlib source sampler prepared, not executed.
alternative_B.adoption: Requires explicit prospective root decision to use this distinct null and relabel the falsifier. It cannot silently stand in for AlternativeA or certify the original per-node degree claim.
alternative_B.scientific_scope: Tests label evidence semantics conditional on exact endpoint native-degree distributions/counts; differences in per-node local degree removal remain possible.

invalid_shortcuts: Retry label permutations until feasible without declaring a different conditioned null
Match only global counts and call it degree matching
Use coarse degree bins/tolerances or approximate heuristic masks while claiming exact per-node matching
Reuse original candidate masks and merely rename their labels, producing a duplicate functional arm
Recompute groups from auxiliary permuted labels or use validation/test labels
Dynamically change active/reference groups to admit the permuted arm
